premises.text: Hearing loss is widespread but rarely treated because clinic aids are burdensome, costly, and unattractive
premises.evidence_span: 650 million people worldwide can't. They're suffering of hearing loss. And only 1 out of 40 gets treated

premises.text: A smartphone app runs calibrated headphone audiology tests and generates personalized hearing-enhancement settings for digital and ambient audio
premises.evidence_span: we took the whole audiology setup and process and squeezed it into a smartphone

premises.text: A dedicated smart hearing enhancer uses the phone only for setup and occasional fine-tuning
premises.evidence_span: we're developing a dedicated smart hearing enhancer where the phone is only used for the initial setup and for fine tuning from time to time

premises.text: Cloud-connected multi-user data improves fitting algorithms and lets users change settings anytime with guidance
premises.evidence_span: you connect it to the cloud and that enables you to change the settings wherever and whenever while getting guidance from MIMI

premises.text: Monetization is free basic app, $5/month premium cloud, and ~$40 subscription for the dedicated earpiece with insurance/service
premises.evidence_span: The basic version of the app is for free. The premium version with the cloud support comes for $5 a month

value.text: Accessible, affordable, attractive hearing enhancement people can start at home
value.evidence_span: we're making hearing enhancement more accessible by really lowering the entry barrier for people like my father by bringing it into the living room

causal_links.evidence_span: show him directly the benefits of hearing better again
We make it more affordable and better by optimizing the distribution and fitting process

notes: Cost/coolness/clinic-burden examples folded into one undertreatment pain (v1.5.1 §4.1.6). Test tones, headphone calibration, and phone mic/processor/speaker enhancement folded as one smartphone audiology+enhancement mechanism (§4.1.7). Dedicated earpiece kept as separately failable hardware path. Age demographics treated as framing for accessibility value. Anti-template: problem, product stack, and monetization separately revisable.
